text_block_list.text: One day, while out with Meisho Doto—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Huh...?! S-Sorry for stopping so 
suddenly...!

Looking in the direction Meisho Doto 
pointed, there was a crane game filled 
with plushies modeled after Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes...! Opera O-san and so many other 
amazing people are there, so... umm~.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I just wondered if holding it might share 
some of that confidence or aura with me...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
B-But still, I'm bad at this sort of 
thing... I won't be able to get it. Even 
if I grab it, it'll just slip and fall 
right out... *sniff*.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Still, if you'd be willing to take it... 
that would make me super happy, maybeee...
—I can't afford to lose this game!!
